title: What Is an Astronomical Unit (AU)? | Space Atlas
description: An astronomical unit is the Earth-Sun distance, about 150 million km. Pick a real-world scale and see how far each planet would actually be.
ogDescription: Turn the Earth-Sun distance into a scale you can walk — and see where every other planet would land.
jsonldDescription: An interactive tool converting the astronomical unit into a chosen real-world step size, showing where each planet would land at that scale.
